text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Biko Pegasus's racing racewear was talked about as "just like a hero!" Having caught wind of the buzz, a tokusatsu magazine reached out requesting an interview and photoshoot.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's start practicing for the interview!
Trainer, countin' on ya!
choice_data_list: —Why did you choose a hero theme for your racing outfit?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
You know, Carrotman taught me
the courage to never give up!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: By showing how they fight, heroes teach us what truly matters!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to be an Umamusume who gives something back through racing too!
That's why I went with a hero-style racing outfit!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Well, until the actual shoot begins...
Umm, what should I do?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Since there was some time left before the interview and photo shoot, I decided to take a walk with Biko Pegasus.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Go! Stand tall! Carrot~♪
Surging through my veins~ is love~ and courage~♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Wearing these clothes
really gives me courage!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Earlier, I said I wanted to become a hero, but that's not all.
This outfit supports me, too!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Work hard so you can be worthy of this outfit!
Have courage! ...Like that, y'know!"
choice_data_list: Let's do our best so you can pull it off!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Ueeeh... *hic*, *hic*...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ngh! Hey there, what's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: *Hic*... My ball is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking over, the ball was floating on the river's surface.
It seemed she had accidentally dropped it in.
choice_data_list: Even for an adult, that looks hard to go grab...
Even for an adult, that looks hard to go grab...

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
My daddy bought me this ball...
It's super important to me... *sob*...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Yo! Ha! Hop!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus hops between the rocks jutting
out of the river, getting closer to the ball.
Soon, she reaches out—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: —I caught it! ...Wait, whoa-whoa-whoa!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (SPLAAASH!)

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Th-Thank you...!
Big sister, are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally fine!
After all, I'm a hero!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking the ball,
the little girl walked back with a smile.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
—...I'm sorry, Trainer!!
I have an interview right after this, but I got my racing outfit dirty.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"I thought I might get dirty.
But I just couldn't turn a blind eye...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus acted in a way worthy of her racing silk.
I can't blame her for that.
The problem is what to do about the photoshoot, though...
choice_data_list: Strike an action pose and make the dirt part of the charm!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her racing outfit is themed after a tokusatsu superhero. I suggested that if we focused on action poses, any dirt might just look like part of the scene...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ooh, like a still photo from a tokusatsu show?! Then getting dirty might actually look cool...!
choice_data_list: Let's try asking a reporter anyway — it's worth a shot!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Courage in my heart, passion on the turf!!
Justice Biko has arrived!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: That was ultra hyped! Next up, show me your special move, please!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Nice!
Special Move: Pegasus Punnnch!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I consulted the photographer about the mud and the pose,
he gave the okay, saying, “That'll look much punchier for the magazine!”
So the shoot moved to the back hill!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Looking good, Biko Pegasus-san!
Even covered in mud, you've got real style...
You're really giving off that indomitable hero vibe!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! No matter how many times you fall, you get right back up!
'Cause that's the kind of hero I look up to!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Biko Pegasus's action photo published in the magazine
became quite the sensation, earning praise for being "so cool!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I told them that whatever the reason may be,
since they'd be blowing off the interview,
they should probably apologize...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
You're right...!
A real hero has to apologize gracefully!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...And that's how my racing outfit got dirty.
Even after you came all this way to see me... I'm so sorry!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. You saved a child.
Besides... an Umamusume who's a hero not just in outfit, but in spirit!
Isn't that just the coolest thing ever?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Please let me apply for an interview again!
Next time, I'll secure more space and do a special feature on Biko Pegasus!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
—Kh! Ah...!
I'm totally down with that!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I'll make sure to get interviewed next time for sure!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later... the special feature on Biko Pegasus
published in the tokusatsu magazine fired up the readers' hearts!
